name: P0: critical
description: Production down / data loss / security breach

name: P1: high
description: Significant impact, must be in current flow

name: P2: medium
description: Important but not urgent, normal backlog

name: P3: low
description: Nice to have, address when capacity allows

name: docs: bypassed
description: Doc gate explicitly bypassed with a reason

name: docs: missing
description: Documentation section is empty — required before Ready

name: docs: verified
description: Docs judged present and real for this change

name: needs: refinement
description: Ticket is not actionable yet, a proposal is on the thread

name: size: L
description: 3-5 days

name: size: M
description: 1-2 days

name: size: S
description: Half day

name: size: XL
description: > 5 days - should be broken down

name: size: XS
description: < 1 hour

name: status: blocked
description: Cannot proceed - dependency or decision needed

name: status: needs-review
description: Work done, awaiting review

name: status: stale
description: No activity for the stale window, closes unless someone acts

name: status: wontfix
description: Acknowledged, not addressing

name: triage: needs-rescope
description: Intent still matters, the issue as written is too vague or too large

name: triage: recommend-close
description: Work looks done or superseded, a human decides

name: triage: still-relevant
description: Reviewed against the repository, the work still needs doing

name: type: bug
description: Something is broken

name: type: chore
description: Maintenance, refactor, upgrade

name: type: epic
description: Top-level initiative

name: type: feature
description: New functionality

name: type: question
description: Needs clarification before work begins

name: type: sub-task
description: Child of a parent issue
